editorial:
Imagine you are working high up in the Australian government, managing the image of the Minister of the Arts. That is exactly where you find yourself in this story. You get pulled into a messy situation when a grumpy artist dies under very strange circumstances. Instead of just ignoring it, the political adviser starts digging into the death to see if something fishy is going on. The vibe is a neat mix of a workplace comedy and a crime mystery, making you feel like you are sneaking around the halls of power while trying to keep your job.

What really works here is the chemistry between the characters and the way the mystery unfolds without getting too confusing. While the pacing slows down a bit in the middle, the acting keeps you interested. If you enjoy stories about politics and secrets, you will love this.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the adviser discovers that the artist did not die by accident. The twist reveals that the death was actually a cover-up involving people within the government who wanted to silence the artist's complaints. After a tense confrontation, the truth comes out and the guilty parties are exposed. The movie wraps up with the adviser finally clearing the artist's name, though it leaves you wondering how many other secrets the government is still hiding.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves political mysteries and dry humor.
